description: Gate 2 fixture for the RLM integration plan. Tests the CampaignGenerator retriever (rpglib + MemPalace) on an RPG-shaped corpus: several converted adventures in wing_rpglib, a small bestiary in wing_bestiary, and one unconverted book in rpglib so the pointer path exercises too. The real corpus lives on the user's machine; this fixture is self-contained so Gate 2 is reproducible in CI.

books.description: Essentials Kit starter adventure with a white dragon menacing the Sword Coast frontier.

books.pdf_title: Obojima — Tales from the Tall Grass
books.description: Japanese-inspired open island adventure with yokai and samurai factions.
Underdark adventure featuring demon lords and drow houses.
Core creature compendium for D&D 5th edition.
Gothic horror adventure in the demiplane of Barovia.
books.notes: Intentionally NOT ingested — queries about Strahd should surface a pointer hit with a suggest_conversion payload.

drawers.section_path: Dragon of Icespire Peak / Icespire Hold
drawers.text: Icespire Hold is the white dragon Cryovain's lair atop the mountain. The approach is a winding ice-sheathed stair; fog rolls down from the summit. Grundar Quartzvein the dwarven foreman was captured during the assault.

drawers.section_path: Dragon of Icespire Peak / Axeholm Ruins
drawers.text: Falcon's camp sits outside the ruined dwarven keep of Axeholm. Harbin Wester, the nervous townmaster, sent the party to scout it.
The kodama tree spirits haunt the bamboo valleys. They speak only in rustling leaves and the clack of wooden chimes. Offerings of rice wine calm them; cutting a sacred tree draws their wrath.

# Kappa
tag: creature
source: OBOJIMA
cr: 1/2
River yokai. Polite but dangerous. Bow to spill the water from its head-bowl and it loses its strength. Prefers rivers and rice paddies.

# Oni of the Crimson Mountain
tag: fiend
source: OBOJIMA
cr: 7
Ogre-like demon with regeneration and a taste for human flesh. Flies on clawed wings; wields a kanabō iron club.

drawers.section_path: Out of the Abyss / Chapter 1 / Velkynvelve
drawers.text: Velkynvelve is the drow outpost where the party begins, prisoners of priestess Ilvara Mizzrym. Escape requires stealing keys from the guard drider and negotiating with other captives like Stool the myconid sprout.

drawers.section_path: Out of the Abyss / Chapter 3 / Darklake
drawers.text: The Darklake is a cavern-sea in the Underdark. Kuo-toa villages line the shores; demonic madness infects the water. Boats made of giant mushroom caps are the local transport.

drawers.section_path: Out of the Abyss / Bestiary / Juiblex
drawers.text:
# Juiblex, the Faceless Lord
tag: fiend
source: OOTA
cr: 23
Demon lord of slimes and oozes. Amorphous form absorbs weapons. Acid aura liquefies organic matter within 10 feet.

# Bugbear Chief
tag: creature
source: MM
cr: 3
Goblinoid warlord. Heart Strike grants +7 damage on surprise attacks; martial advantage on allied flanks.

drawers.section_path: Monster Manual / Dragons / Ancient White Dragon
drawers.text:
# Ancient White Dragon
tag: dragon
source: MM
cr: 20
Arctic apex predator. Ice Walk, Cold Immunity, Frightful Presence. Breath weapon is a 90-foot cone of freezing air.

# Owlbear
tag: creature
source: MM
cr: 3
Feywild predator with bear body and owl head. Multiattack claws + bite. Keen Sight.
